title: GTA 6 Squeaks Into The Game Awards 2026 Eligibility

content:
## GTA 6 Squeaks Into The Game Awards 2026 Eligibility

As one of the most anticipated mega-games of this generation, Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to dominate gaming headlines. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, this massive title has managed to qualify for The Game Awards 2026 by the absolute smallest of margins—a mere matter of a single day.

The strict eligibility windows of The Game Awards often create dramatic cut-off scenarios for late-year releases, and GTA 6 appears to have secured its spot just under the wire. This narrow timing has instantly turned the 2026 award show into an even more exciting prospect for the industry and fans alike.

### Can It Break Records?

With its eligibility confirmed by this tight margin, the big question circulating within the gaming community is whether GTA 6 can challenge and ultimately break the record number of wins currently held by Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. While it remains to be seen how the competition will shape up when the time comes, the sheer scale and cultural impact of a Rockstar Games release always position it as a heavyweight contender for major accolades.

## Editor's Take

Qualifying for TGA 2026 by a single day is the ultimate cliffhanger for GTA 6. It guarantees that the mega-game will have its shot at glory in the year of its release, setting the stage for what promises to be one of the most competitive and talked-about award shows in gaming history.
